issue.title: validate says a file in a folder named "..config" does not exist, although it does
issue.body:
My drawing lists `..config/app.yml` in a component's `files`. The file exists in the repository (the folder is literally named `..config`), and the path is repository-relative (it has no `..` segment), so validation accepts its form. But `archdrawer validate` reports it as missing and fails. The editor's `check-files` also marks such paths (`..env`, `..config/app.yml`) as missing. I expected an existing file to pass.

Reproduction:
```
mkdir -p repo/.git repo/..config && echo x > repo/..config/app.yml
# repo/arch.archdraw.json: the bundled example with facts.components[0].files = ["..config/app.yml"]
archdrawer validate repo/arch.archdraw.json
```
Output:
```
ERROR facts.components[0].files[0]: "..config/app.yml" does not exist in the repository
1 error(s)
```
(exit 1). In a repository holding `..env` and `src/app.ts`, `POST /api/diagrams/<id>/check-files` with `{"files": ["..env", "src/app.ts", "nope.ts"]}` answers `{"missing":["..env","nope.ts"]}`.

expected.cause: The `within` helper of repoFileChecker in src/server/files.ts treats any relative path whose text starts with ".." as outside the root (`r.startsWith("..")`), which also rejects names like `..env` or `..config/…` that are inside it.
